name: app-calendar-app-with-floating-category-tags-and-cards
title: Calendar App with Floating Category Tags
whatItIs: A white slide with a month-view calendar phone at centre surrounded by floating coloured tag pills (School, Home, Plants, Friends, Work, Sport, Grandma) and activity cards with big coloured letter blocks, plus a headline 'Where your time finally makes sense'.
whatItMeans: Colour-coded tags scattered around the phone show how categories carry through the app, and letter blocks give each card a friendly identity.
techniques: Tag pills floating around the device as a visual system
Colour-coded dashes on the calendar matching the tags
Cards with large initial letters in coloured tiles
White canvas so the colours pop
Light large headline set beside the phone
bestFor: Feature explainers with floating UI parts

vocabulary.definition: Interface parts pulled out and floated around the device.
A coloured pill classifying an item.
A colour block with an initial used as an icon.
